item.description: Hear works that use multiples of the same instrument: Rakhi Singh’s violin(s) in Julia Wolfe’s music for 9 bagpipes; guitars in music by Rhys Chatham; and violas and viols in work by Donnacha Dennehy. In each of these musical experiments, there is also an unusual approach to the tuning. item.title: Teaching Kids to Read: How One School District Gets It Right
item.description: The schools in Steubenville, Ohio, are doing something unusual—in fact, it’s almost unheard of. In a country where nearly 40 percent of fourth graders struggle to read at even a basic level, Steubenville has succeeded in teaching virtually all of its students to read well. item.description: Tibet House Benefit at Carnegie HallMarch 3. 7:30PM. $51-$200 Every year for 39 years, Philip Glass and friends have presented a benefit concert for Tibet House at Carnegie Hall. item.title: Anton Batagov at Klavierhaus
item.description: Anton Batagov: Selected Letters of Sergei Rachmaninoff at KlavierhausMar. 4, 8PM Sergei Rachmaninoff, the great 20th century Russian composer, is buried just north of New York, in Westchester County.
